review.notes: Structure check found no code fences; heading outline, figure embeds and captions were screened against the PDF text layer for all 42 pages and the prompt-box banner on p21 was verified on a render. Full-document normalized word diff of extracted PDF text against the OCR markdown was screened for droppage; every remaining gap is figure-internal transcript/telemetry text, rotated arXiv stamp, the PDF's soft-hyphen line breaks (e.g. 'prepara-tion', 'immedi-'/'ately'), or LaTeX-equivalent math (Eq. 5 and Eq. 11 including the Lynch and Park citation were confirmed present). The dropped title-page footnote, the prompt-box banner heading, sixteen glued table cells in Table 3 and the square-root signs standing in for check marks in Table 6 were verified on rendered pages (p1 at 200 dpi, p13 table at 210 dpi, p21 box at 200 dpi, p23 text layer plus render). 'due a TL/TS' (Resume at TL / TS row), the flattened two-line Table 8 headers ('AlpaSim Score all ↑') and 'Z. Gharamani'-style printed quirks absent here were checked and left as printed by the PDF.
